headline: Taiwan Export Orders Surge 62.4% in September as Local Currency Weakens
summary: Taiwan's export orders totaled $114.2 billion in September, climbing 62.4% year-on-year, while the central bank noted net foreign equity sales of $19.4 billion between Oct. 12 and Oct. 16.
why: Taiwan is a bellwether for the global electronics and semiconductor supply chains due to its contract manufacturing base.

impacts.name: Taiwan Technology Exporters
impacts.why: A weaker New Taiwan dollar enhances foreign exchange competitiveness and export revenues.
